description: Work out how many months it takes for a refinance to pay for itself once switching costs are counted, and what the net saving is after them. Call this rather than estimate_refinance_savings when someone is deciding whether a switch is worth doing, not just how much a lower rate saves. Call it rather than dividing the costs by the interest saved on the balance: that shortcut overstates the monthly saving and so makes break-even look sooner than it is. Switching costs are an argument — this tool does not assume a figure, because they vary by lender and by state and most lenders don't publish theirs. Use lookup_discharge_process for the lender-stated discharge fee where there is one. This models a variable loan: if they are on a fixed rate, the break cost belongs in switchingCosts and usually decides the answer on its own.

currentRate.description: The rate they're on now, as a percentage, e.g. 6.8.

newRate.description: The rate being switched to, as a percentage, e.g. 6.2.

switchingCosts.description: Total one-off cost of switching in AUD. ASK WHETHER THEY ARE ON A FIXED RATE FIRST. Breaking a fixed term costs thousands to tens of thousands and dwarfs everything else here — a $14,000 break fee turns a nine-month break-even into seven years and reverses the recommendation. It is the figure that decides the answer and the one nobody volunteers, because people think of their loan by its rate, not its term. Then add the current lender's discharge fee, the new lender's application and settlement fees, and state mortgage registration and deregistration. Required: there is no sensible default and a guessed one changes the answer.

termYears.description: Years remaining on the loan. Defaults to 30.

name: estimate_refinance_break_even

breakEvenMonths.description: Months until the accumulated saving covers the switching cost. Null when the new rate is no better, in which case it never breaks even.

monthlySaving.description: Monthly difference, AUD. Zero if the new rate is higher.

netSavingFirstYear.description: Saving over 12 months less switching costs, AUD. Negative early on.

netSavingOverTerm.description: Saving over the remaining term less switching costs, AUD.

title: Estimate refinance break-even
